title: Filling: verdict colours, the worst verdict wins, and the truck diagram
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  • A template with a Per axle field with several rows and positions.
  • Fill it, giving some positions verdicts and leaving some without.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm a value's input is tinted by its verdict and stays neutral while nothing is entered.
2. Confirm a row's verdict is derived from its positions and an axle's from all its positions, worst wins (Not OK over Monitor over OK over N/A), and neither is chosen directly; a position with nothing entered does not affect its row, and a row or axle with nothing entered is Not inspected.
3. Confirm the truck diagram shows every axle and tints each tire by the worst verdict of the rows measuring it, staying grey until one of its rows has a verdict.
4. Select a tire in the diagram and confirm it moves to that axle, row and tire.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A value's input is tinted by its verdict and stays neutral while nothing is entered.
  • A row's verdict is derived from its positions and an axle's from all of its positions, worst wins (Not OK over Monitor over OK over N/A), and neither is chosen directly.
  • A position with nothing entered does not affect its row, and a row or axle with nothing entered is Not inspected.
  • A diagram of the truck shows every axle and tints each tire by the worst verdict of the rows measuring it, staying grey until one of its rows has a verdict.
  • Selecting a tire in the diagram moves to that axle, that row and that tire.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9106 (S8 — Record measurements per axle); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S8; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R13: “The value's input will be tinted by its verdict and will stay neutral while nothing is entered”
  • S8-R14: “A row's verdict will be derived from its positions, and an axle's from all of its positions. Worst wins: Not OK over Monitor over OK over N/A. A position with nothing entered does not affect the row. A row or axle with nothing entered is Not inspected. Neither will be chosen directly”
  • S8-R18: “A diagram of the truck will show every axle and will tint each tire by the worst verdict of the rows measuring it. A tire will stay grey until one of its rows has a verdict”
  • S8-R19: “Selecting a tire in the diagram will move to that axle, that row and that tire”

Amended on 5 October 2026
S8-R14 changed on 29 September 2026 (Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905 (read on 5 October 2026)): worst wins now ranks N/A last, a position with nothing entered does not affect its row, and a row or axle with nothing entered is Not inspected. The S8-R14 quote above is the current wording, and step 2 and the expected results follow it.

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
